result.topic_en: Astronomical observation records for 17 and 20 March: repeated altitude measurements of Gamma Cephei and Alpha Ursae Minoris (Polaris) with clock times, barometer and thermometer readings, clock corrections, and reduction to a polar altitude (latitude) of about 51° 31′ 54″.

methods.what: Repetition-circle measurement: summing repeated altitude readings and dividing by the number of repetitions to get a mean zenith distance (401°24′59″25 over 10 observations → 40°8′35″64)
Reduction to the meridian: summing per-observation corrections for hour-angle offset from culmination and adding to the measured arc
Computation of culmination time from right ascension plus clock (Shelton) correction
Refraction correction from barometer and thermometer via logarithms
Determination of latitude (polar altitude) from corrected zenith distance of the pole star and its polar distance
